contexts.text: A closed idea appeared like black points...
Thus do truths prick.
In spiritual writing there are punctations over the letters, which exalt the sense. DSS 72. TCR 241.
Hence certain Hebrew letters are pointed within...
It is believed (that the first substance) may be likened to a point, which is of no dimension...
There is (in this case) no fixed point from which as a beginning these differences may be deduced...
The will... cannot be moved a pointlet except by delight.
They do not agree in one point...
(They would conceive) that the origin of substances and forms is from points...
He should believe that not a point of justification is from himself.
Until this doctrine carries every point of their minds.
This doctrine carries every point in Christian Churches...
The end in view carries every point.
Does not free will carry every point in these?
It appeared to me as if man were a kind of solid point, around which is the sphere of the Spirits; for... the earthly things of man are represented by such a solid point...
Therefore Hebrew was written in the beginning without the points; and, when it is read without the points, the sense only is attended to. (Continued. See Hebrew language.)
Forms in which nothing can be conceived except a centre in every point...
Can prick others so sharply...
The life in the body is only a point of life.
See Hebrew language.
The delights of these evils sting.
This is why many of the harsh letters are pointed within...

This is done by the various punctations over the letters (in the Word in the Spiritual Kingdom): When the punctations signify affections, the series of the punctations express the interior things of intelligence constantly before the more intelligent Angels.
(Love and wisdom) are in the least point a one... It is said every point and least; but there is not meant a point or least of space; for this has no existence in the Divine.
5. 3. The vowels (in spiritual writing) are not written, but are punctated.
